gloss: to run around; to rush about

definitions.gloss: to run around; to rush about
definitions.explanation: To run around energetically in various directions, or to rush from place to place handling tasks.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{庭|にわ}で{駆|か}け{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The children are running around in the garden.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{駆|か}け{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: I was rushing around all day for work.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{嬉|うれ}しそうに{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る。

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{駆|か}ける (to run, to gallop) + {回|まわ}る (to go around)

TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) - takes を for the area being covered or で for the location

USAGE:
Can describe both playful running (like children or animals) and busy rushing between tasks.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {走|はし}り{回|まわ}る: to run around (similar meaning, slightly more neutral)
- {駆|か}け{上|あ}がる: to run up
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}む: to rush in
